subject: general
question: As of July 2022, what is the required age bracket of a subscriber to the Atal Pension Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18-40 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **required age bracket** for a subscriber to the **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)** is **18-40 years**.
 
• APY is a government-backed pension scheme in India primarily targeted at the unorganized sector.
 
• The scheme aims to provide a defined pension, depending on the contribution and its duration.
 
• Subscribers can choose a monthly pension ranging from ₹1000 to ₹5000 to be received after the age of 60.
 
• The contributions by the subscribers are invested by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) in accordance with the investment guidelines prescribed by the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atal Pension Yojana** was launched by the Government of India in **May 2015**.
 
• The scheme is named after the former Prime Minister of India, **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• It is administered by the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)** through the National Pension System (NPS).
 
• The government co-contributes to each eligible subscriber's account, subject to certain conditions, to encourage participation in the scheme.
 
• Subscribers can exit from the scheme before 60 years of age under exceptional circumstances like terminal illness or death.
